Yet, in these moments of solitude, I've also come to realize the value of [deep] parental bonds. I've learned to cherish the quiet dinners and one-on-one conversations with my parents, where we can connect on a deeper level and share our thoughts and feelings without distraction. (These moments have taught me the importance of [emotional] intimacy and connection, and have helped me to develop a more nuanced understanding of family relationships.)
